entries.name: shape-guard-removed
entries.claim: The SQLSTATE shape guard in postgresCode is what keeps a non-SQLSTATE string `code` (Node ERR_*/ECONNREFUSED, foreign refusal tokens) out of the INVENTORY_POSTING_STORAGE_REJECTED relabelling; this mutation restores exactly the unguarded sniff ADR-0049 observed misdiagnosing on main.

kills.name: posting error translation: a non-SQLSTATE code keeps its own error identity
posting error translation: a five-character non-SQLSTATE code keeps its own error identity

entries.name: shape-guard-refuses-everything
entries.claim: The shape guard is discriminating, not a wall: a guard that refuses every code stops classifying real SQLSTATEs as storage rejections and stops recognizing a genuine PostgreSQL duplicate-key error on the 23505 replay branch, which then surfaces raw.

kills.name: posting error translation: a SQLSTATE-shaped code is relabelled as a storage rejection
kills.expected: a real SQLSTATE must still be classified as a storage rejection

kills.name: posting error replay: a genuine duplicate-key error reaches the 23505 replay branch
kills.expected: duplicate key value violates unique constraint

entries.name: admission-narrowed-to-the-replay-code
entries.claim: The SQLSTATE admission twin dies alone: a guard admitting only the replay branch's own 23505 still keeps the duplicate-key replay control green, so the twin is what holds the claim that every SQLSTATE-shaped code is still classified as a storage rejection.

kills.name: posting error translation: a SQLSTATE-shaped code is relabelled as a storage rejection
kills.expected: a real SQLSTATE must still be classified as a storage rejection

entries.name: replay-branch-stops-recognizing-23505
entries.claim: The duplicate-key replay control dies alone: defeating only the catch's 23505 recognition, with the shape guard and ordinary SQLSTATE translation intact, relabels a genuine PostgreSQL duplicate-key error as a storage rejection instead of resolving it through the replay branch.

kills.name: posting error replay: a genuine duplicate-key error reaches the 23505 replay branch
kills.expected: a genuine 23505 must be resolved by the replay branch, not relabelled as a storage rejection

entries.name: shape-guard-length-only
entries.claim: The charset half of the shape check is load-bearing on its own: a guard that checks only for five characters admits a five-character value outside [0-9A-Z] into the storage-rejection relabelling.

kills.name: posting error translation: a five-character non-SQLSTATE code keeps its own error identity

entries.name: shape-guard-charset-only
entries.claim: The length half of the shape check is load-bearing on its own: a guard that checks only the [0-9A-Z] alphabet admits ECONNREFUSED, which is entirely uppercase, into the storage-rejection relabelling.

kills.name: posting error translation: a non-SQLSTATE code keeps its own error identity
